messages:
elaine (Sales): kicking off POC scoping for Midas Corp — they care about high-precision retrieval + rerank, tool-calling for invoice actions, and strict audit logs. can we align success criteria and quick blockers?
marco (Solutions): noted. quick Q — do they need 32k context or will segmented retrieval + embeddings be enough?
priya (ML Eng): for invoices, probably fine with 8k if we chunk and use embeddings + rerank. 32k helps for full-thread summarization but ups cost and infra.
dan (Product): success criteria suggestion: 1) 95% accepted rerank precision on top-3, 2) <200ms median gen latency for tool calls, 3) end-to-end demo with audit logs and KMS in 10 business days. thoughts?
amanda (Security): log retention and KMS are musts. need SOC2 export checklist answered and SAML for SSO. also question about data-in-transit to dedicated nodes?
elain (typo) — elaine (Sales): amanda reminder sent within the thread — can you list the exact items you need so we can map POC scope to the security questionnaire?
amanda (Security): sure — SAML metadata, KMS provider (AWS KMS/HSM), audit log format (NDJSON), retention policy options (30/90/365d), cert for private control plane.
marco (Solutions): on model selection: propose gpt-open-8k-quantized for gen+toolcall in hosted, and gpt-open-32k for fallback when we want long context demos. use embedding model embed-lite-v2 for retrieval. reranker can be lightweight cross-encoder on CPU.
priya (ML Eng): agree — also propose cached KV for repeated invoice templates to drop latency. we should run 200 sample prompts against both 8k and 32k variants to compare token cost + perf.
dan (Product): pricing ask from customer: what does a short POC like this cost? can we offer a trial credit + estimate of expected token cost?
marco (Solutions): recommend: free credits for first 200k tokens + optional Dedicated trial (1-week) pricing at flat rate $X/day — I'll pull exact numbers from commercial.
elaine (Sales): ok. timeline: day 0-2 security signoffs, day 3-4 dataset ingest and prompt set, day 5-7 evals & rerank tuning, day 8 demo + acceptance. is that feasible?
priya (ML Eng): tight but doable if data is ready. need sample invoice dataset by EOD tomorrow.
amanda (Security): confirm we can start with redacted data for the first run — that removes data-residency blocker.
marco (Solutions): technical checklist for POC (posting here so we don't lose it):
- dataset: redacted invoices CSV + retrieval index (FAISS)
- prompts: 50 golden prompts + 150 edge cases
- eval metrics: top-1/top-3 precision, false positive rate, latency percentiles
- infra: hosted endpoint + optional Dedicated nodetype, KMS config, SSO test
- fallbacks: if 8k fails precision threshold, auto-route to 32k model variant for that request
- audit: NDJSON logs sent to S3 (demo)

code snippet for fallback rule (example):
```
if rerank_precision_top3 < 0.95:
  route_to = "gpt-open-32k"
else:
  route_to = "gpt-open-8k-quant"
```

elaine (Sales): love the checklist. marco can you attach estimated token burn for the eval run by EOD? also need a short acceptance matrix I can send to customer.
marco (Solutions): will do. acceptance matrix (draft) to share:
- Functional: top-3 precision >=95% on golden set (50)
- Performance: median toolcall latency <200ms, p95 <500ms
- Security: SAML + KMS configured, logs to S3
- Operational: deployable within Dedicated/Demo env, rollback plan

priya (ML Eng): small note — p95 latency depends on batching. we'll run with batch=1 for latency SLO.
elaine (Sales): action items: marco token estimate + acceptance matrix, priya run sample evals, amanda security checklist items, customer informed of redacted-data start. demo scheduled day 8. who owns demo script?
dan (Product): i'll own demo script and success narrative.
marco (Solutions): starting token estimate now. tagging deploy-bot to remind of nightly infra snapshot: @deploy-bot please run snapshot Wed 00:30 UTC for POC sandbox.
deploy-bot: snapshot scheduled for 2024-10-16T00:30:00Z :white_check_mark:
elaine (Sales): thanks all — will sync tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
